value.rationale: Velocity third cumulant is a natural non-Gaussian measure of propulsion-induced directional asymmetry. The exact threshold is a complete, parameter-uniform qualitative phase boundary, independent of the asymmetry magnitude and additive thermal noise, while other cubic cumulants retain their sign. It distinguishes inertial velocity statistics from position statistics and identifies a stiffness-driven sign reversal invisible to second moments and symmetric models.
